figures.title: Post-TIPS Encephalopathy Mechanism
figures.alt: Diagram illustrating the mechanism of Post-TIPS Encephalopathy, showing a TIPS shunt diverting portal blood, bypassing the liver, and leading to ammonia accumulation in the brain.
